summary: Added a Cockpit BFF route for confirmed-metric source PDFs at /api/extraction-eval/confirmed-metric-coverage/source.
The BFF route forwards an explicit request API key or configured NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY to the protected backend source route.
The route fails closed with DATA_MISSING when no API key can be forwarded.
The Verification detail panel disables source opening with DATA_MISSING when no Cockpit API key is available.
